subject.title: [Bug]: Regression: User-configured heartbeat prompt no longer respected

question: Should maintainers refresh the conflicting open fork PR that references this issue, or supersede it and allow a new narrow same-repo heartbeat fix?
rationale: The bug remains source-reproducible, but the issue is already marked linked-pr-open and no-new-fix-pr while the open closing-syntax fork PR is conflicting, so automation should not start a replacement until maintainers choose the fix path.

options.title: Supersede With Same-Repo Repair
options.body: Close or supersede the conflicting fork path and sponsor one focused same-repo fix with regression tests for custom prompts and transcript-marker behavior.

options.title: Refresh The Fork PR
options.body: Ask the fork PR author or a maintainer to rebase https://github.com/BingqingLyu/openclaw/pull/228 and add current proof before review.

options.title: Hold For Heartbeat Owner Review
options.body: Keep this issue open without a new repair until the heartbeat prompt-boundary owner confirms the exact fix scope.

recommendation.title: Supersede With Same-Repo Repair
recommendation.body: Close or supersede the conflicting fork path and sponsor one focused same-repo fix with regression tests for custom prompts and transcript-marker behavior.
